question: Who had founded the first Women’s University in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhondo Keshav Karve**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhondo Keshav Karve** founded the first Women's University in India.
 
• The university is known as **SNDT Women's University (Shreemati Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Women's University)**.
 
• It was established in **1916** in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• Dhondo Keshav Karve was a prominent social reformer and educator who dedicated his life to the cause of women's education and empowerment.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **1958** for his immense contributions to society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The establishment of SNDT Women's University marked a significant milestone in the history of women's education in India.
 
• The university initially started with just five students and has now grown to accommodate thousands of students across various disciplines.
 
• SNDT Women's University has several campuses and affiliated colleges spread across **Maharashtra **and other states.
 
• The university offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs, catering to the educational needs of women from diverse backgrounds.
 
• Dhondo Keshav Karve's vision and efforts have had a lasting impact on the progress and empowerment of women in India.
